title: Employers with Insufficient Insurance Coverage for Migrant Domestic Workers' Medical and Hospitalisation Bills
what_it_is: Employers with Insufficient Insurance Coverage for Migrant Domestic Workers' Medical and Hospitalisation Bills

sections.label: MDW medical insurance requirements
sections.summary: MOM requires employers of Work Permit holders including MDWs to buy medical insurance, and enhanced requirements from 1 July 2023 raised the annual claim limit to $60,000.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: To support employers in meeting these obligations, the Ministry of Manpower (MOM) requires all employers of Work Permit holders, including MDWs, to purchase medical insurance for their workers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: In the last five years, about 95% of all hospitalisation bills by MDWs fell within $15,000, which was the minimum insurance coverage required before 1 July 2023.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: MOM has since enhanced the medical insurance requirements for new policies or renewals and this took effect from 1 July 2023.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The higher annual claim limit of $60,000 is estimated to cover about 99% of all bills.

sections.label: Employers seeking medical social worker help
sections.summary: Employers facing financial difficulties paying their MDW's medical bills may approach medical social workers at public healthcare institutions for assistance.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Employers who face financial difficulties paying for their MDW's medical bills may approach medical social workers at the public healthcare institutions for assistance.

sections.label: No MediSave for MDW bills
sections.summary: Individuals cannot use MediSave for their MDWs' medical bills, which should be covered by MOM-mandated insurance, and employers facing difficulties may approach medical social workers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Individuals will not be able to use MediSave to pay for medical bills incurred by their MDWs who should be covered by the medical insurance mandated by MOM.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Employers who face difficulties paying the medical bills of their MDWs despite the insurance coverage may approach medical social workers, which I mentioned earlier on.

sections.label: Employers advised to approach social workers
sections.summary: Employers unable to meet obligations of paying for their migrant domestic workers' medical expenses are asked to approach medical social workers in public healthcare institutions for advice.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Again, for employers who are unable to meet their obligations of paying for the medical expenses of their migrant domestic workers, we ask that they approach the medical social workers in our public healthcare institutions for advice.
